dngos su blang ba'i dam tshig bcu bzhi po las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni phas pham pa zhes bya'o// de yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mi 'gro ba lta bus der 'gyur ram zhe na/ de tsam gyis der mi 'gyur te/ spang zhing dor bar mi bya'o// zhes pas de las der 'gyur ba yin no zhes gdams pas/ dkon mchog gsum spong bas gcig rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya slob dpon spong bas bzhi/ sbyin pa rnam bzhi spong bas bzhi/ phyi dang gsang ba theg gsum spong bas gsum/ sdom pa 'dzin pa dang*/ mchod pa spangs pa gnyis te bcu bzhi'o// 'di la mi mthun pa mang bas 'dir kun dga' snying pos de nyid bsdus pa dum bu dang po'i 'grel par/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// zhes bya ba la sogs par phas pham bcu bzhi las bzlog pa'i mtshan nyid can no zhes dang*/ dpal mchog dum bu gnyis pa'i 'grel chen las kyang*/ bsams pa tsam gyis 'di dag thams cad 'grub pa yin te phyag rgya la sogs pa 'di dag gis ci zhig bya zhes bya bas 'di yongs su spangs na pham par 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ bu ston gyis spyi rnam du 'di gnyis drangs nas lugs 'di bsgrub par mdzad pa de'i rjes su 'brang ngo*// dkon mchog gsum ma spangs kyang bag med pas skyabs su mi 'gro ba lta bu sogs yan lag gi ltung ba dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo dang*/ rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang*/ dpal mchog la sogs pa shin tu mang por gsungs pa rnams ni rjes su mthun pa'i dam tshig dang*/ ldog pa pham pa dang yan lag gi ltung ba ci rigs pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa nyams su blang ba'i dam tshig ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum rdor sems kyi dang*/ 'dod chags chen po la snyoms par 'jug pa de bzhin gshegs rigs dang*/ de bzhin gdug pa'i skye bo bsdigs pa'i phyir khro bor ston pa rnams rdo rje'i rigs kyi dang*/

las thams cad rang bzhin dag pas spyod pas padma dang*/ 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa rin po che ste/ dum bu rang rang gi gzhung las bshad pa rnams so// nyams na phyir 'chos pa ni/ bzlas pa sbyin sreg dbang nod pa sogs so/// / bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi sdom pa la mtshan nyid ni lus ngag yid gsum rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi thabs shes zab mo'i bdag nyid du bsdams pa'i tshul khrims so// dbye ba ni/ bum dbang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i sngags sdom dang*/ gsang dbang gi shes rab ye shes kyi/ shes rab ye shes chen po'i dbang gi ngo bor gyur pa'i lam/ phyi ma gnyis la dbang gsum pa'i dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bor gyur pa zhes gdam pa'o// de dag gi 'jog byed kyang*/ lus ngag yid gsum bskyed rim gyi thabs shes zab mo'i bdag nyid du bsdams pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ rdzogs rim mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i thabs shes/ mtshon byed dpe'i thabs shes/ mtshon bya don gyi thabs shes so// de yang bum pa'i dbang ni/ lus dag pa dang sprul sku mngon du byed pa'i nges pas/ phung khams skye mched lhar ngo sprad pa las byung ba'i rigs lnga'am drug gi dam tshig dag 'dzin pa yin no// gsang dbang du ni ngag rlung dag pa dang*/ longs sku mngon du byed pa'i nges pas rtsa ba yan lag gi rlung bcu dbu mar sdom pa nyid yin no// 'dir phyi nang gi rten 'brel las phyi nang gsang ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa yan lag dang bcas pa dam tshig tu 'gyur ro// shes rab ye shes su yid thig le dag pa dang chos sku mngon du byed pa'i nges pas khams 'dzag pa phyi nang gsang ba'i bdag nyid can du sdom pa ste gtso bor phyag rgya gsum dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig rnams so// bzhi par ye shes dag pa dang ngo bo nyid kyi sku gzhi 'bras dbyer med nyid mngon du byed pa'i nges pas gzhi las gzhan du gyur pa'i sems kyis 'pho ba'am 'dzag pa'am g.yo ba dag sdom pa'o// 'dir rtsa rlung khams kyi mtshan nyid can gyi sdom pa rnams las kyang bsdam par bya dgos te/

gang du bsdam bya sdom byed phra rags de thams cad kyang gzhi'i gnas tshul las gzhan du gyur pa kho na yin pas so// de bas na ma bcos pa nyid dam tshig thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang*/ 'di la drang ba'i thabs su sdom pa'i rim pa ji snyed pa dag byung zhing*/ sems can gyi rnam par rtog pa de snyed so so la bltos nas sdom pa re rer yang 'gyur bas sa ma ya 'bum sde zhes rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod la grags pa yin no// de dag gang las len pa'i cho ga ni/ bum dbang dang*/ gsang dbang dang*/ dbang gsum pa dang*/ dbang bzhi pa zhes bzhag pa'i thabs bsdus pa'am 'bring ngam rgyas pa mos pa dang mthun pa kho nas 'thob ste/ thob pa 'di ka dbang*/ 'di ka sdom pa/ 'di ka nyams len zhes bya'o// 'di la yang sta gon gyi dus su thob pa rnams smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa'i dus su thob pa la 'jug pa'i tha snyad byas kyi/ sdom pa rang gi ngo ti ni dbang gi dngos gzhi la ste/ dus der dbang thob pa'i brda sprod pas so// ji ltar bsrung ba'i tshul la/ bsrung bya rtsa ltung bcu bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa/ bsgrub bya rigs drug gi dam tshig nyams su blang ba dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig nyams na phyir 'chos pa dang bzhi las/ dang po la/ rtsa ltung dang*/ yan lag gi ltung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba slob dpon la brnyas pa dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' las 'das pa dang*/ rdo rje'i spun la khro ba dang*/ khyad par bzhi ldan gyi byams pa spong ba dang*/ kunda lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems spong ba dang*/ rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa dang*/ yongs su ma smin pa la gsang ba sgrogs pa dang*/ rang gi phung po la brnyas pa dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la the tshom za ba dang*/ g.yo sgyu'i byams pa'am gdug la byams pa dang*/ ming sogs bral ba'i chos la der rtog pa dang*/ dad dang ldan pa'i sems sun dbyung ba dang*/ dam tshig gi rdzas mi brten pa dang*/

bud med smod pa ste bcu bzhi'o// de dag la yul gyi dang*/ bsam pa'i dang*/ sbyor ba'i dang*/ dus kyi dang*/ nyes pa'i dang*/ lan grangs kyi bye brag ste sgo drug gis bsgyur bas ltung ba brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ de dag lci 'bring yang ba gsum gyis bsgyur bas nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis so// yul bsam sbyor ba mthar thug gi shan 'dra ba so so'i char gtogs la/ pham pa dang ltung bar gyur pa snga ma'o// lci ba dang sbom po yan lag dang nyes byas phra mo ste lnga ni yan lag tu gtogs so// rang dbang nyams pa dang*/ dbang thob pa las nyams pa dang*/ nus pa rnyed pa dang*/ gzhan don du 'gyur ba dang*/ skye ba med pa brtan par bya ba'i ched dang*/ rgyud las gnang ba'i skabs dang*/ bla ma la sogs pa'i lung thob pa dang*/ srog gi bar chad du gyur pa'i dus spyad pa rnams nyes med do// de dag ni bum dbang gi dus su bsgrags pas thams cad bum dbang la bltos pa'i rtsa ltung du song snyam pa ltar ga la yin/ brgyad pa bum dbang gi mi mthun phyogs/ dgu pa gsang dbang*/ bcu pa sher dbang*/ bcu bzhi pa bzhi pa'i/ dang po gsum skyabs su 'gro ba'i/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i/ drug pa spyi'i/ bdun pa dam tshig rang gi lhag ma gsum spyod pa'i mi mthun phyogs so// bum dbang gi dus su bsgrag pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa len pa'i sngon du bslab pa'i gnas brjod pa lta bu'o// phas pham pa dang ltung bar 'gyur mi 'gyur dbang so so la bltos la/ bum dbang du yang de dag las log par bya ni dgos so// gnyis pa yan lag la/ rig ma bsnyen pa la dga' ba dang*/ tshogs 'khor gyi nang du rtsod pa dang*/ rig ma'i bdud rtsi len pa dang*/ gsang chos gzhan la mi ston pa dang*/ dang bas dris pa'i lan gzhan ston pa dang*/ nyan thos nang du zhag bdun 'dug pa dang*/ sngags par smra ba dang*/ snod min la bshad pa ste brgyad do// gzhan yang nyer brgyad dang bzhir bshad pa dag kyang ngo*// gnyis pa bsgrub bya rigs drug gi dam tshig ni/

sngar bshad pa'i rtse mo ltar ram/ lhag par dus kyi 'khor lo drang nges ma phye bar gsungs pa/ phye ste bshad pa gnyis byung ba'i dang po/ rdo rje'i rigs la rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma gzung ba/ rin po che la sbyin pa/ rnam snang gi rigs la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang ba/ don grub la mchod pa/ padma'i rigs la sdom pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs la sems bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ srog gcod pa/ brdzun smra ba/ ma byin par len pa/ gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog pa/ bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa/ padmar mi smad pa drug rdo rje/ ral gri/ rin po che/ padma/ 'khor lo/ gri gug rigs kyi dam tshig tu gsungs pa rnams so// gsum pa nyams su blang ba dang 'brel ba'i dam tshig la/ yo byad kyi dam tshig longs spyod kyi dam tshig mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig rjes spyod kyi dam tshig bzhi'o// phyir 'chos pa ni/ nyi shu rtsa lnga snying po rgyan las bshad pa ltar ram/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas dbang bdun tsam thob pa la rtsa ltung byung na lha grangs re rer bzlas brjod sum khri drug stong bya ba dang*/ phyis gdams pas dang*/ bum pa dang gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob pa la byung na chad pa'i las dang dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas slar nod/ dbang gong ma gnyis la tshogs bsags pa dang sdig bshags lhag par so so rang rig pa'i stobs kyis sbyangs so// ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur dngos grub thob mi 'gyur// zhes pa'o// phan yon ni/ tshe gcig la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ste/ pha rgyud las/ rig pa'i skyes bu/ ma rgyud las/ rig ma'i skyes bu/ don zung 'jug ma ning gi go 'phang zhes bzhag pa kha sbyor yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po 'thob pa'o/// / sdom pa gsum gyi snying po bstan pa zhes bya ba/ rje bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang pad dkar dbang po'i ched du/
padma dkar pos dpal bkra shis mthong smon du cho 'phrul gyi zla ba la sbyar ba tshul khrims rin po che la thams cad spyod par gyur cig// /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
